messages.author: c92f3b5ece7c4318
messages.subject: Re: Data table filter issue
parts:
I am able to identify the root cause of the issue. It looks like the file from which table reads data is not in utf-8 format due to which the error has been thrown. I have changed the format of file from ascii to utf8 using the below commands. 

iconv -c -f ascii -t utf8 trng1.csv > trng1utf.csv

mv trng1utf.vsv trng1.csv


The above command solved the issue. 

Thanks Yihui for your reply.


Regards,

Soundari
